blocks.html: Watch a live stream in your browser through the MTX page in Deploy App.

slides.title: Find the stream
slides.html:
• Streams that are broadcasting now are marked LIVE
  • Search in Search streams... by callsign or tool (icu, gopro, uas, ipcam)
  • Select the stream you want to watch

slides.title: Play the stream
slides.html:
• Press Play stream
  • The video plays on the page
  • If you see Stream is offline, the stream is not broadcasting right now: go back with Back to streams

slides.title: Watch outside Deploy App
slides.html:
• Select Connection Options
  • Under Download Packages, press Browser
  • Open the downloaded file in your browser
  • The file contains your username and password: do not share it, and delete it when you no longer need it

slides.title: You can now watch a stream
slides.html:
• You can close this guide.

To watch with a separate player app, continue to VLC Player
